column1: # Golden frames, reference frames kept in the tree. A frame row shows the fixture
# in a 256x192 canvas with the bar hidden, after the keys; a thumbnail row is
# the thumbnail the grid makes. Keys are nsxiv's, space-separated; C-n is
# Ctrl and n. A name ending in -down uses the default scale mode, which shrinks
# a large image to fit and leaves a small one at 100%.
